notes: v2.9.32: wheel zoom now rescales the vertical price axis from the currently visible candles so price swings remain readable instead of looking flat. Only real price overlays (EMA5/20/60/112/224/448, blue line and kijun) may participate in price-axis scaling; diagnostic arrays such as volume EMA, boolean signal inputs and disparity values are explicitly excluded. Nearby long EMAs/cloud values are included, but distant overlays are clipped from autoscale so they cannot crush the candle range. Maximum zoom depth is increased from 25 bars to 15 bars, with tighter vertical padding at higher zoom. Arrow, watermelon, Bowl-3, accumulation and live-order logic remain unchanged.
